lines.text: Many learners say: I studied whole night.
Say all night, or the whole night.

data.why: Say all night, or the whole night.

native.tip: हिंदी में “पूरी रात” कहते हैं, इसलिए लोग whole night बोल देते हैं। अंग्रेज़ी में all night या the whole night बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी ऐसा बोलते हैं? “I studied whole night.” 😅 सही वाक्य है: “I studied all night.” ध्यान रखें: “all night” या “the whole night.” ऐसे बोलें। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “all”। याद रखें: all night या the whole night बोलें। अब all night के साथ अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners say “whole night,” but English says “all night” or “the whole night.”
en.caption: Do you say this? “I studied whole night.” 😅 The right sentence is: “I studied all night.” Remember: say “all night” or “the whole night.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
